# The full documented exception shape set for Converse/ConverseStream,
# fetched verbatim from the "Errors" sections of
# https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_Converse.html
# and
# https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_ConverseStream.html
# (fetched 2026-09-02) -- 10 distinct shape names across both operations'
# documented error lists (AccessDeniedException, InternalServerException,
# ModelErrorException, ModelNotReadyException, ModelTimeoutException,
# ResourceNotFoundException, ServiceUnavailableException,
# ThrottlingException, ValidationException from the common "Errors" list,
# plus ModelStreamErrorException, which only appears in ConverseStream's own
# in-band `ConverseStreamOutput` union). This is the vendored authority for
# both this profile's `[errors]` table keys and every exception-type literal
# `decode.rs` recognizes.
